[!cgo] skip

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo

# Accept: the .lgo marker serves the fast path and the call computes;
# malformed markers (extra field, outside the preamble) stay inert
# without corrupting the call. The trampoline each shape reaches is
# asserted in cmd/cgo/internal/testlogos TestFastcallMarkerCallPath.
cd fastlgo
logos build -o $WORK/fastlgo$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/fastlgo$GOEXE
stdout '^ok fast-call-markers$'
go tool objdump -s '_Cfunc_ladd_ok' $WORK/fastlgo$GOEXE
stdout 'logosCgocallFast'
cd ..

# Reject: a marker with no matched C function fails.
mkdir $WORK/obj-ghost
! go tool cgo -objdir $WORK/obj-ghost -importpath example.com/fast ghost/f.lgo
stderr 'no matched C function'

# Recover: a nocallback fast-called C function that calls into Go still
# panics; recovering it must leave a clean fast call working, and both
# the violating and the clean call must take the trampoline.
cd viol
logos build -o $WORK/viol$GOEXE .
cd ..
exec $WORK/viol$GOEXE
stdout '^recovered: runtime: function marked with #cgo nocallback called back into Go$'
stdout '^ok viol-clean-fast$'
go tool objdump -s '_Cfunc_vfast' $WORK/viol$GOEXE
stdout 'logosCgocallFast'
go tool objdump -s '_Cfunc_cadd' $WORK/viol$GOEXE
stdout 'logosCgocallFast'

-- fastlgo/go.mod --
module example.com/fastlgo

go 1.27

-- fastlgo/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- fastlgo/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	arityp "example.com/fastlgo/arity"
	nonprep "example.com/fastlgo/nonpre"
	okp "example.com/fastlgo/ok"
)

func main() {
	if okp.Add(1, 2) != 3 || arityp.Add(1, 2) != 3 || nonprep.Add(1, 2) != 3 {
		fmt.Println("FAIL fast-call-markers")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("ok fast-call-markers")
}

-- fastlgo/ok/f.lgo --
package ok

/*
#include <stdint.h>
//logos:cgo_fastcall ladd_ok
int ladd_ok(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
*/
import "C"

func Add(a, b int32) int32 { return int32(C.ladd_ok(C.int(a), C.int(b))) }

-- fastlgo/arity/f.lgo --
package arity

/*
#include <stdint.h>
//logos:cgo_fastcall ladd_arity extra
int ladd_arity(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
*/
import "C"

func Add(a, b int32) int32 { return int32(C.ladd_arity(C.int(a), C.int(b))) }

-- fastlgo/nonpre/f.lgo --
package nonpre

/*
#include <stdint.h>
int ladd_nonpre(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
*/
import "C"
//logos:cgo_fastcall ladd_nonpre

func Add(a, b int32) int32 { return int32(C.ladd_nonpre(C.int(a), C.int(b))) }

-- ghost/f.lgo --
package fast

/*
#include <stdint.h>
//logos:cgo_fastcall ghost_fn
int ladd(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
*/
import "C"

func Add(a, b int32) int32 { return int32(C.ladd(C.int(a), C.int(b))) }

-- viol/go.mod --
module example.com/viol

go 1.27

-- viol/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- viol/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func violate() (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg, _ = r.(string)
		}
	}()
	Violate()
	return "returned"
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("recovered:", violate())
	if got := Clean(); got != 42 {
		fmt.Println("FAIL viol clean fast call")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("ok viol-clean-fast")
}

-- viol/fast.lgo --
package main

/*
extern int gobump(int v);

//logos:cgo_fastcall vfast
static int vfast(void) { return gobump(41); }

//logos:cgo_fastcall cadd
static int cadd(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
*/
import "C"

//export gobump
func gobump(v C.int) C.int { return v + 1 }

func Violate() int32 { return int32(C.vfast()) }

func Clean() int32 { return int32(C.cadd(20, 22)) }
